title: GNSS: fix typos and rename variable in SBAS L1 dissector
description:
Fix typos on SBAS L1 UDREI and rate of change of ephemeris time correction and
rename variables for rate of change of ephemeris time correction
to align with  ICAO Annex 10, Vol I.

commits_data.title: GNSS: rename SBAS L1 MT25 rate of change of ephemeris time correction
commits_data.message:
GNSS: rename SBAS L1 MT25 rate of change of ephemeris time correction

By ICAO Annex 10, Vol. I, the SBAS L1 MT25 rate of change of ephemeris
time correction is identified as delta a_f1.

commits_data.title: GNSS: fix typo for SBAS L1 MT25 rate of change of ephemeris time correction
commits_data.message:
GNSS: fix typo for SBAS L1 MT25 rate of change of ephemeris time correction

By ICAO Annex 10, Vol. I, the MT25 rate of change of ephemeris time
correction has a resolution of 2^-39 s/s (not 2^-32 s/s).

commits_data.title: GNSS: fix typo on SBAS L1 UDREI mapping
commits_data.message:
GNSS: fix typo on SBAS L1 UDREI mapping

By ICAO Annex 10, Vol I., UDREI value 5 represents 0.8315 m^2
(not 0.8313 m^2).
